nodes.long_description:
Feel the joy and excitement of real snooker!

•Bring the full-sized snooker table into your home with Mixed Reality.
•Novel table alignment system means you can play your strokes just like in real life.
•Now supports Real Cue Attachment. Play with your own cue exactly like you do in real life.
•Free Play mode enables you to practice with your favourite routines.
•Pass and Play Match Play lets you enjoy an exciting match with your friends on a single headset.
•Online Match Play lets you play online with your friends and players from all around the world.
•Climb to the top of Online Leaderboards and become the best in the world.

See you at the table!
